DGreatVerse VIP
Go VIP
Unlock verification for your communities, custom skins,
free experiences & higher group limits.
Verified communities
Every community you own gets the verified badge, so members can tell it's the real one.
Exclusive skins & themes
VIP-only app themes and profile styling, on top of the free ones.
Free experiences
Occasional perks and drops, VIP members only.
Bigger group & community limits
Create more groups — up to 30 instead of the free limit of 10 — plus higher member caps.
Ad-free
No ads anywhere in the app while your VIP is active.
—
per month
📌 After verification, staying verified costs $0.33/mo — auto-deducted from your wallet every month to keep the channel maintained and secured. If your wallet doesn't have enough when it's due, the channel is snoozed until the fee is paid: it stays visible to followers, but the post section will just show "pay for maintenance before you use" until you top up your wallet and pay.
Cancels anytime. If VIP lapses, groups already created over the free limit stay — you just can't create new ones until you're back under it.
Blocked Contacts
Blocked contacts are removed from your contacts panel and their messages won't reach you. Unblock anyone here to restore them.
Hidden Chats Recovery
If you ever forget a hidden chat's PIN, tap "Forgot PIN?" when unlocking and use any of these to get back in on this device. Verifying doesn't change the chat's PIN.
